description_en:
You must integrate at least one method to obtain results: webhook callback or task status polling. Both methods can be integrated simultaneously.
•If you choose the webhook callback method, prepare a receiving endpoint in advance and implement it according to the following request parameters and response elements.
•After the recognition task is completed, the platform pushes the result to your service based on the callback URL bound to the task
description_zh:
需要至少需要接入一种结果获取方式：webhook 回调或任务状态查询；两种方式可同时接入。
•若用户选择 webhook 回调方式，需要提前准备好接收接口，并按以下入参和出参实现。
•当识别任务结束后，平台将根据任务绑定的回调地址向业务方推送结果
